messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — we're planning the public release announcement for next Wed 09:00 PT :rocket: Need final changelog link, docs URL, canary timing and a short approved benchmark line. Draft post below, pls comment.
Marco: Can you paste the exact changelog path? I'll bench the canary window and autoscale schedule.
Aisha: Changelog draft is at `docs/releases/2026-03-30-release-notes.md` (working). Docs page will be `/docs/release/1.13` — Tess can you confirm the final permalink?
Tess: I can finish the docs today. I'll push to prod at 18:00 PT and the final link will be https://docs.redwood.com/release/1.13 — I'll add the examples anchor and migration snippet.
Marco: Eng suggests staged rollout: canary 09:00-11:00 PT at 10% -> 50% if metrics ok. I'll open autoscale window from 08:30-12:00 PT and post pod counts. Also callout: update the benchmark narrative in the blog to avoid claiming global numbers.
Ravi: Webinar is same day at 14:00 PT — keynote will quote bench numbers. Marketing, do we have approved figures and a one-line slide blurb? If not, tag the data team.
Aisha: Bench numbers are in the internal report https://reports.redwood.com/benchmarks/1.13; for public we should use a conservative headline: "up to 35% lower latency on common prompts" and link to the full report. Inbound lead routing: please set HubSpot campaign = release_1_13 and route demo requests to Sales > SDR Queue A.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Canary rollout config referenced in infra/canary-config.yaml. Scheduled window pending Marco's command.
Marco: Final canary deploy command I'll run: ./deploy --tag release-1.13 --canary 10%:2h --region us-west1 — after that I'll watch error rate + p95 latency, then push 50% if stable.
Aisha: Two last asks: changelog must include a short "breaking changes" section and explicit migration notes for Dedicated customers. Tess — can you add a one-paragraph migration snippet? If not, we shift the announcement.
Tess: Adding migration snippet now, short example + steps. Will ping this thread when live :thumbsup:
Ravi: Great. I'll update webinar slides to use the conservative bench number and include a slide with the link to the full benchmark doc. Who's owning the release-day triage Slack channel?
Aisha: I'll own triage + marketing QA for release day. Marco owns rollout, Tess owns docs, Ravi owns slides/product. Ping here when docs URL is live so I can update the announcement copy.
Marco: Noted. I'll post a release-ready message with links and the canary config once the deploy is staged.
Aisha: Thanks everyone — once Tess confirms the docs URL I'll lock the announcement copy and send the embargo calendar invite to press + partners :eyes:
